recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat FHIR-7229 as historically applied and now superseded by the MedicationRequest workflow rename; no current core source change is needed for this seed.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy issue from DSTU1 asking that MedicationPrescription be generalized to MedicationOrder rather than remain prescription-focused; the resolution says the resource was now called MedicationOrder through a separate applied request.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly names FHIR-7229, but commit 9d6493a912 applied the same change family for FHIR-7224 and FHIR-5896 by mechanically renaming MedicationPrescription to MedicationOrder across source/fhir.ini, history, Composition sample content, and ElementDefinition examples. That matches FHIR-7229's resolution that another request had applied the rename.
additional_context: FHIR-10456 was later Published/Persuasive with Modification and approved changing MedicationOrder to MedicationRequest with Medication Order as an alias for workflow alignment. Current source/fhir.ini lists MedicationRequest as the active resource, documents the old-name transition, and maps MedicationOrder to MedicationRequest. The current MedicationRequest StructureDefinition explains that the resource name intentionally generalizes beyond MedicationPrescription and MedicationOrder, and Zulip discussion from 2016 gives the same rationale.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit with no source changes. The current source is already correct for the seed when later decisions are considered; changing it back to MedicationOrder would contradict FHIR-10456 and current workflow naming.
